, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated Khufu with his son Khafre and misinterpreted the Britannica info, incorrectly claiming Khufu was buried in the Pyramid of Khafre. In reality, Khufu’s burial is in the Great Pyramid of Giza (King’s Chamber).
